metadata.article_title: Parties to be subject to Court’s jurisdiction.

article.title: Parties to be subject to Court’s jurisdiction.
article.content:
4Parties to be subject to Court’s jurisdiction.

Order 36, Rule 4
Where the agreement has been filed, the parties to it shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the Court and shall be bound by the statements contained therein.
